courierReport.title: Delivery & RTO
courierReport.sub: How each courier delivers: on time against the promise, refused at the door, by zone and district — and what returned parcels cost. One denominator: parcels with a final outcome.

kpi.lateNote: with a courier, past the promise

courierReport.byDistrictNote: The {n} districts with the most parcels.
courierReport.none: Nothing finished in this period yet.
courierReport.practice: {n} practice parcels (a courier before its keys pass the Test) are left out.
courierReport.cut: Only the first {n} parcels were read; choose a shorter period.
courierReport.lateNone: No parcel is past its promise.
courierReport.lateMore: Showing {shown} of {n}. The full list: Delivery › parcels, the Late view.

rto.title: RTO cost book
rto.sub: What each returned parcel cost: both courier legs, packaging, handling and the ad share you count.
rto.off: Off. When on, it reads only the shop's own returned parcels (never sample rows). The figures come from Money › Costs & fees.
rto.floor: {n} parcels miss a figure you have not entered yet, so this is the least it cost. Enter them on Money › Costs & fees.
rto.none: No parcel came back in this period.
rto.productNote: A parcel with several products shares its cost by pieces.

claims.title: Claims
claims.sub: Money you ask this courier for: a lost or damaged parcel (its declared value) or a rider's extra. A record only — the courier pays on its statement.
claims.off: Raising claims for lost or damaged parcels is off.
claims.toClaim: Lost or damaged, not claimed yet
claims.amount: Amount (৳), if not the declared value

rider.title: Rider issues
rider.sub: A customer says the rider took more than the parcel asked. Log it with a photo, then approve or reject. Approving opens a courier claim for the exact extra.
rider.off: Rider issues are off. Switch them on under More options.
rider.charged: What the customer paid the rider (৳)
rider.words: What happened, in the customer's words
rider.approveNote: Why you approve (e.g. the receipt photo shows it)
rider.refundAsk: Ask a refund of exactly {extra}? It waits for the owner's approval on Money; nothing is paid now.
rider.refundAsked: Refund asked — waits for the owner's approval.
rider.refundAskLabel: Allow asking a refund of the extra (the owner still approves every refund)

err.default: That did not work. Try again.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
err.PROOF_REQUIRED: Add a photo of the proof first.
err.NO_EXTRA: The customer paid no more than the parcel asked.
err.ALREADY_OPEN: This parcel already has an open one.
err.NOT_CLAIMABLE: This parcel's records do not show it lost or damaged.
err.NOT_OPEN: Someone moved it first. Reload the page.
err.OVER_REFUNDABLE: More than can be refunded on this order.
err.REFUND_NOT_ALLOWED: The refund rules do not allow this.
err.STALE: Someone saved first. Reload the page.
